name: Triangle-free graphs without independent 10-sets (Ramsey number R(3,10))
description: construct() -> {'n': n, 'edges': [[u, v], ...]}: a simple graph on vertices 0..n-1 with 1 <= n <= 41. It must contain no triangle and no independent set of 10 vertices; both conditions are checked by exact branch and bound. Maximize n. A valid graph on n vertices certifies R(3,10) > n. The survey records 39 as the largest known order, and R(3,10) <= 41 limits any valid graph to 40 vertices.

state_of_the_art.statement: Largest known triangle-free graph with no independent 10-set has 39 vertices (Exoo 1989), so 40 <= R(3,10); Angeltveit (2025) proved R(3,10) <= 41. A 40-vertex graph would prove R(3,10) = 41.

science_relevance.scientific_problem: Determine the Ramsey number R(3,10), the least n forcing a triangle or an independent 10-set.
science_relevance.importance_rationale: R(3,k) is the central off-diagonal Ramsey function (Erdős Problem #165), and R(3,10) is the smallest classical two-colour case with an unknown value; a 40-vertex graph would settle it.
